description:
This kids’ electric scooter is designed for young riders seeking a safe, enjoyable, and confidence-building riding experience. Equipped with a 130W motor and a reliable 24V lithium battery, it delivers smooth, controlled performance at speeds ideal for children.
Featuring three selectable speed modes, the scooter allows parents to set appropriate limits as riders learn and gradually progress. The lightweight yet durable frame ensures easy carrying and storage while safely supporting riders up to 154 lbs.
A long-lasting battery provides up to 8 miles of range on a single charge, making it well suited for neighborhood rides and park use. The scooter fully recharges in just 3–4 hours, and the removable battery design allows for convenient maintenance and replacement.
Designed with safety, durability, and fun in mind, the scooter also includes built-in ambient LED deck lighting to enhance visibility and add a stylish touch. It is an excellent choice for kids enjoying their first electric scooter experience.

10mphTop Speed

Up to 3-5 miles Range

130W Hub Motor

24V 2600 mAh
